selection: Union of commit date 2026-10-26 in UTC and in America/Sao_Paulo, including two late-evening Brazilian commits dated 2026-10-27 UTC. Complete master history query was paginated.
scope: Public PHP SDK, local protocol tests, and documentation. No consumer API, production deployment, or operations on real accounts.

commits.title: fix(auth): wait for the server to restart the connection after pairing (#328)
changes: Wait for post-ADV server restart by 515 or transient close; bounded 15-second fallback; stop and replacement connections retain lifecycle ownership.
The shared read/query path enforces the 15-second deadline during a pending IQ and rejects late results before public node events or correlation.

commits.title: fix(auth): register a pending pairing code again after a reconnect (#327)
changes: Re-register a pending pairing code on a replacement connection with new ephemeral exchange, original lifetime, no push, and manual-refresh event on failure.

commits.title: fix(client): send history.requireFullSync in the pairing DeviceProps (#326)
changes: historyRequireFullSync constructor option reaches DeviceProps during initial companion registration.

commits.title: feat(signal): report a status for each phone number in the lid sync result (#325)
changes: Per-phone status in/out/invalid/error/unanswered; optional protocol diagnostics and backoff; exact input correlation and isolation across batches.

commits.title: fix(transport): bind socket events and noise sessions to their connection (#323)
changes: Connection-owned socket/Noise lifecycle, generation guards and cancellation of superseded queries. JavaScript Promise/Blob waiter details do not have a synchronous PHP equivalent.

phpCompatibilityChoices: PHP uses the named constructor option historyRequireFullSync rather than the TypeScript nested options object.
exists remains nullable; an LID without an explicit contact verdict remains unanswered. This preserves the documented PHP registration-verdict contract.
Pending pairing codes are memory-only and retain their original expiration across re-registration.

independentReview.pairing: passed after adding pending-IQ deadline enforcement and regression tests

limitations: Skipped cases were reported by the local suite; no claim that those environment-dependent cases executed.
Local protocol validation does not demonstrate new QR/code pairing or full history availability in real WhatsApp clients.
